exercises.instructionEn: workbook — ENTERPRISE 1 BEGINNER — Virginia Evans, Jenny Dooley — Express Publishing
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — KITOBNING OLD MUQOVASI.

  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami ham yo'q.


MUQOVADA NIMA BOR:

  1) KITOB TURI:
     'workbook' = mashqlar daftari

  2) SERIYA NOMI:
     'ENTERPRISE 1'

  3) DARAJA:
     'BEGINNER' = boshlovchi

  4) MUALLIFLAR:
     Virginia Evans
     Jenny Dooley

  5) NAShRIYOT:
     Express Publishing

  6) RASM:
     Gollandiya uslubidagi ShAMOL TEGIRMONI
     (a windmill). Chap tomonda yashil
     chiziqda yulduzcha porlaydi.


⚠ 'WORKBOOK' NIMA DEGANI:

  'work' + 'book' = ish + kitob
  = mashqlar daftari

  Qo'shma ot — ikki so'zdan yasalgan,
  BIRGA yoziladi.

  Shunga o'xshash:
     'a notebook' = daftar
     'a textbook' = darslik
     'a handbook' = qo'llanma
     'a cookbook' = oshpazlik kitobi


⚠ 'ENTERPRISE' SO'ZINING MA'NOSI:

  'enterprise' = 1) tashabbus, jasorat
                 2) korxona

  Kitob nomi sifatida — 'jur'at, yangi
  ishga qo'l urish' ma'nosida.


⚠ 'BEGINNER' — DARAJA:

  Enterprise seriyasining darajalari:
     Enterprise 1 — Beginner (boshlovchi)
     Enterprise 2 — Elementary
     Enterprise 3 — Pre-Intermediate
     Enterprise 4 — Intermediate

  'begin' + '-er' = beginNer
  (⚠ 'n' ikkilanadi)


MUALLIFLAR HAQIDA:

  Virginia Evans va Jenny Dooley —
  Express Publishing nashriyotining
  eng ko'p kitob yozgan mualliflari.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a workbook  = mashqlar daftari
  a coursebook = darslik
  a windmill  = shamol tegirmoni
  a beginner  = boshlovchi
  a cover     = muqova
  an author   = muallif

points.noteUz:
'work' + 'book' — QO'SHMA OT, birga yoziladi.

Shunga o'xshash: a notebook (daftar),
a textbook (darslik), a handbook (qo'llanma).

'enterprise' = tashabbus, jasorat; korxona.

Seriya darajalari:
1 Beginner → 2 Elementary →
3 Pre-Intermediate → 4 Intermediate

Ikki muallif — Express Publishing
nashriyotining eng ko'p kitob yozgan
mualliflari.

points.en: a windmill (the picture on the cover)
points.noteUz:
'wind' (shamol) + 'mill' (tegirmon)
= a windMILL.

Yana bir qo'shma ot!
